claims.evidence: The witness report only describes a single 3-seater sofa across all photos.
No receipt or proof of purchase date provided.
Wide shots in photos 0-2 are insufficient to rule out small tears or stains; the back is not shown.
Physical firmness cannot be determined from static images.
Odors cannot be detected through photos.

risks.risk: Internal frame damage or low-quality construction.
risks.proof: A video of a person sitting and shifting weight to check for creaks or sagging.
risks.if_unproven: as having a weakened or low-grade wooden frame.

risks.risk: Damage to the rear fabric or underside.
risks.proof: Photos of the back of the sofa and the underside (dust cover).
risks.if_unproven: as having significant tears or wear on non-visible surfaces.

risks.risk: Inaccurate sizing for the intended space.
risks.proof: Photos showing a measuring tape against the length, height, and depth.
A close-up video of the fabric texture and seller's written guarantee.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring professional deep steam cleaning.

proof_requests: Photos of the 2-seater mentioned in the description.
Photos of the back and underside of the 3-seater.
Dimensions (length, width, height) using a measuring tape.
A short video of someone sitting on the cushions to demonstrate foam resilience.
response.reason: The witness has identified the item as a 3-seater sofa, allowing for a worst-case valuation. The seller's claim of a 2-seater is ignored as it was not seen by the witness.
